description.title: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום
description.summary: This table details exclusions to a pollution liability insurance policy. It specifies events or actions not covered by the policy, such as war or deliberate non-compliance.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום מכסה נזקים כתוצאה מזיהום, אך אינה מכסה מלחמה, כולל מלחמה לא מוכרזת או מלחמת אזרחים. הפוליסה אינה מכסה פעולות מלחמה על ידי כוח צבאי, או התערבות של ממשלה במניעת או הגנה מפני התקפה. תקופת הארכה זמנית עומדת על שישים (60) יום.

sketch:
L. War
War, including undeclared or civil war;
Warlike action by a military force, including action in hindering or defending against  an  actual  or  expected  attack,  by  any  government,  sovereign  or  other authority using military personnel or other agents; or
Insurrection,  rebellion,  revolution  or  usurped  power,  or  action  taken  by  any government, sovereign or other authority in hindering or defending against any of these.

This table details exclusions to a pollution liability insurance policy. It specifies events or actions not covered by the policy, such as war or deliberate non-compliance.
ממדים: exclusion type, description of exclusion

L. War
War, including undeclared or civil war;
Warlike action by a military force, including action in hindering or defending against  an  actual  or  expected  attack,  by  any  government,  sovereign  or  other authority using military personnel or other agents; or
Insurrection,  rebellion,  revolution  or  usurped  power,  or  action  taken  by  any government, sovereign or other authority in hindering or defending against any of these.
